name: datalib-latchkey-runtime
//: Bazel-managed replacement for the `npm install latchkey@<v>` that datalib/tauri/stage-runtime.sh used to run against the live registry. One dependency, pinned to LATCHKEY_VERSION in datalib/backend/runtime/src/node_runtime.rs; //tools:version_pins_test keeps the two in step.

pnpm.//: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: no package's install scripts run. This tree is 7 packages, and one of them is `playwright`, whose postinstall downloads ~400 MB of browser binaries that appear in no lockfile. The playwright package itself ships (the wizard's browser login imports it); the browsers do not. `ensure-browser` picks the system's Chrome instead, and a download stays something a person runs by hand.
